name: Monterde (Spain)
description: White field flanked by pales of the bars of Aragon with pointed edges, with two blue horizontal stripes, charged with a green mount surmounted by a shield of the bars of Aragon.
history: The flag is a white cloth of proportion 2:3, with a green triangular mount surmounted by a small shield of the Royal Sign of Aragon and two blue horizontal stripes at a distance of a ninth of the width from the upper and lower edges, flanked vertically by the Royal Sign of Aragon (nine horizontal bands alternately yellow and red).

features.role: pale of yellow and red bars with a pointed edge along the hoist
pale of yellow and red bars with a pointed edge along the fly
horizontal stripe near the upper edge
horizontal stripe near the lower edge
triangular mount surmounted by a small shield of the bars of Aragon
